next.reason: 1985: 'The NEXT phrase must be specified for files in dynamic access mode, when records are to be retrieved sequentially.'; 2023: 'the NEXT phrase is implied if any of the following phrases is specified: ADVANCING, AT END, or NOT AT END.'. 1985 requires an explicit NEXT for sequential reads in dynamic mode. 2023 implies NEXT when ADVANCING, AT END or NOT AT END is given, so READ ... AT END without NEXT is now accepted.
